title: Peninsula Film Festival: Talks & Workshop at Rosebud Cinema
summary: The Peninsula Film Festival is Mornington Peninsula's iconic film festival running across three days in January. The Festival kicks off with a launch and feature film screening on Friday Jan 8 at Rosebud Cinema 7pm, followed by a Q&A and nibbles and drinks.
